name: CIAM
summary: A council of modern architects who met in congresses from 1928 to 1959. Its members wrote the rules for the functional city. A younger group, Team 10, broke its doctrine.

sources.title: Wikipedia: International Congresses of Modern Architecture

statement.text: Architecture is a social and economic act, and the architect must plan the whole city as a machine for living.
statement.title: La Sarraz Declaration

moves.text: Twenty-eight architects met at La Sarraz and founded the congress.

source.title: Wikipedia: International Congresses of Modern Architecture

moves.text: The fourth congress sailed to Athens and wrote the rules of the functional city, later called the Athens Charter.

source.title: Wikipedia: International Congresses of Modern Architecture

moves.text: At the ninth congress in Aix-en-Provence the younger members attacked the doctrine of the functional city.
The congress dissolved at its last meeting in Otterlo.

source.title: Wikipedia: International Congresses of Modern Architecture
